text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright had a solid run in the GⅠ 
race without any trouble. Sensing real 
progress, she happily shared her joy with 
you after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Mejiro Dober talked 
about their futures. During their 
conversation, Mejiro Bright brought up the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright for the Classic Triple 
Crown, and Mejiro Dober for the Triple 
Tiara. They promised to dedicate their 
respective triumphs to the Mejiro family.
